title: Flat local maps with regular source and fibre have regular target
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Assume that $R$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], that the closed fibre $S/\mathfrak m_RS$ is regular, and that $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $S$ is regular.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 031E (lemma-flat-over-regular-with-regular-fibre); its proof uses Lemma Tag 00ON (dimension-base-fibre-equals-total)
